d: Soft pastel pink hair is styled into two low, fluffy pigtails with blunt bangs framing a youthful, adolescent face. The wide, expressive eyes are a vibrant lime green. A slender build is dressed in a scout-inspired outfit consisting of a white short-sleeved capelet over a tan button-down shirt, paired with dark olive-brown trousers, knee-high grey socks, and dark brown oxfords with orange laces. Signature accessories include a white headband, a brown utility belt with various pouches, a brown satchel adorned with a yellow flower and a blue feather, and a large wooden recurve bow with a quiver of blue-fletched arrows.
